s: Notice the fast city pace and say you’re in a hurry

a.d: In São Paulo, life moves fast. Say “Estou com pressa” (I’m in a hurry) and “Tenho que ir”. Locals say “tô correndo” and “vamos nessa”. False friend: “pressa” means hurry; “pressão” means pressure.

p: Today you meet Paulistano Rui, from São Paulo. Today you tell someone you are in a hurry.

lines: Oi, Sam! Tudo bem? Desculpa, tô com pressa.
Hi, Sam! All good? Sorry, I’m in a hurry.
I am, I have a meeting at nine.
Then I won’t hold you up.
Obrigado. Vamos tomar um café depois?
Thanks. Shall we have a coffee later?
Daqui a pouco, umas três da tarde.
In a bit, around three p.m.
Perfeito. Preciso ir, já passou da hora.
Perfect. I have to go, it’s past time.
